scope: Additive explicit modeled-skater participation metadata preservation and labeling only
behavior: Recognize only version skater-participation-frequency-v1, event positive_minutes, probabilityStatus uncalibrated_model and calibration unavailable
Whitelist public input/evidence hashes, limitations and sampleSize; discard raw numerator, denominator, game/history IDs and unknown fields
Retain null-probability participation receipts and model classification; deny probability/sampleSize when totals permission is absent
Label explicit matched model estimate/calibration unavailable; absent or unrecognized metadata remains unclassified
Do not infer confirmed out from a modeled zero; permissions/ranking/forecast math otherwise unchanged

checks.command: npm test -- --run __tests__/pages/start-chart.test.tsx -t 'public participation model|source assumptions|without inferring an exclusion'

typecheck.inventoryScope: Web TS/JS source plus package/package-lock/tsconfig; excludes dependency trees and generated Next files. More inclusive than compiler root files, not a separately resolved dependency graph.

boundaries: Synthetic engineering regressions and coordinated compilation only; no genuine-input/model run, source/production writes, publication or deployment qualification
